figurative_meaning_en: A person who makes contradictory statements, a liar
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একজন দ্বিজিহ্বা ব্যক্তি, সামনের মুখে এক কথা বলে এবং পিছনে অন্য।
রাজনীতিতে অনেক দ্বিজিহ্বা লোক দেখা যায় যারা প্রতিশ্রুতি ভঙ্গ করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a two-tongued person, saying one thing to the face and another behind the back.
In politics, many double-tongued individuals are seen who break their promises.
history: Derived from Sanskrit 'dwijihvā', implying duplicity in speech, commonly used in classical Bengali literature to denote insincerity.
note: The term originates from ancient linguistic roots emphasizing verbal duplicity.
